# BytePortal

> BytePortal (https://www.byteportal.tech/) is a technical publication delivering honest AI tool reviews, head-to-head comparisons, and practical developer tutorials to boost productivity and simplify workflows.

## Key Information
- Domain: https://www.byteportal.tech/
- Focus: Practical AI tools, LLM benchmarks, cloud emulators, coding agents, productivity workflows.
- Standards: Hands-on tested, factual, fluff-free, zero sponsored bias.

## Core Articles
- [Coolify vs Dokploy: Which Self-Hosted PaaS Wins in 2026?](https://www.byteportal.tech/coolify-vs-dokploy/): Head-to-head comparison of Coolify v4 and Dokploy on a $5 VPS, analyzing idle RAM consumption, Laravel vs TypeScript architectures, Traefik and Caddy reverse proxies, multi-server clustering, and operational failure modes.
- [n8n Self-Hosted: AI Workflows Without the Zapier Bill](https://www.byteportal.tech/n8n-self-hosted/): Hands-off guide to self-hosting n8n with Docker for AI agent and automation workflows, covering execution-based pricing, the Sustainable Use License limits, the real ops cost, and where the free Community edition stops.
- [Dokploy: Self-Hosted PaaS for Docker Apps](https://www.byteportal.tech/dokploy/): Guide to Dokploy, a free open-source PaaS that installs on a VPS with Docker Swarm, Traefik, PostgreSQL, and Redis to deploy Git apps, Compose stacks, and databases with SSL and backups - plus the real cost of running your own control plane.
- [ArtCraft: 13+ Free Open-Source Adobe Alternatives in Pure Rust](https://www.byteportal.tech/artcraft-apps/): Overview of the 13+ native desktop applications in the ArtCraft suite replacing Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere, and Office with lightweight, GPU-accelerated Rust binaries and zero subscriptions.
- [Run AWS Locally on Your Laptop with AWS Emulator](https://www.byteportal.tech/aws-emulator/): Complete guide to running AWS services (S3, DynamoDB, SQS, Lambda) locally with AWS Emulator for zero cloud costs, rapid iteration, and fast coding agent feedback loops.

## Site Structure & Verification
- [About BytePortal](https://www.byteportal.tech/about/): Editorial mission, team, and testing methodology.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.byteportal.tech/privacy/): Data handling, cookies, and privacy compliance.
- [RSS Feed](https://www.byteportal.tech/feed.xml): Machine-readable RSS 2.0 feed of all articles.
- [XML Sitemap](https://www.byteportal.tech/sitemap.xml): Full URL directory for web indexers.
